# Nexus AI

Nexus AI is an AI document Q&A and RAG knowledge assistant by Beyond Tech Intelligence.

## Public product
- Homepage: /
- Developer documentation: /docs
- Interactive workspace: /app (authenticated; do not index)
- Login: /login (do not index)
- Signup: /signup (do not index)

## Verified capabilities
- Selectable-text PDF upload up to 25 MB
- PDF text extraction and overlapping chunk creation
- Neon Postgres persistence for documents and chunks
- Hybrid retrieval over persisted chunks: Postgres full-text search plus pgvector similarity, merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- Groq-hosted model access through a server-side adapter
- Source documents, page references, retrieved passages, and retrieval metadata
- Natural conversation for simple greetings without document retrieval

## Data and security notes
- Passwords are stored as salted scrypt hashes, never plaintext.
- Session tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes and sent in HttpOnly cookies.
- Uploaded documents and account data require authentication in the application API.
- Scanned PDFs without selectable text require OCR, which is not currently included.
- Do not infer compliance, zero retention, or end-to-end encryption claims from this file.
